title: Lead, Software Engineering
description:
**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK**

  
 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 
 Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work
 
  list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 






  
 





**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**










 You’ll join our Application Engineering experts within the
 
 AI, Insights \& Solutions 
 
 team. This team is part of Bain’s digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You’ll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data\-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human\-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.
 






  
 

  
 





**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 




* Design, develop, and maintain cloud\-based AI applications, leveraging a full\-stack technology stack to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and secure solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data scientists, and other engineers, to define and implement analytics features and functionality that meet business requirements and user needs.
* Utilize Kubernetes and containerization technologies to deploy, manage, and scale analytics applications in cloud environments, ensuring optimal performance and availability.
* Develop and maintain APIs and microservices to expose analytics functionality to internal and external consumers, adhering to best practices for API design and documentation.
* Implement robust security measures to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.
* Continuously monitor and troubleshoot application performance, identifying and resolving issues that impact system reliability, latency, and user experience.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to the establishment and enforcement of coding standards and best practices to ensure high\-quality, maintainable code.
* Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in cloud computing, data analytics, and software engineering, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the capabilities of the analytics platform.
* Collaborate with DevOps and infrastructure teams to automate deployment and release processes, implement CI/CD pipelines, and optimize the development workflow for the analytics engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with and influence business consulting staff and leaders as part of multi\-disciplinary teams to assess opportunities and develop analytics solutions for Bain clients across a variety of sectors.
* Influence, educate and directly support the analytics application engineering capabilities of our clients



  



  

* **ABOUT YOU**
**Required**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* **6 years minimum experience** 
 , 3\+ years at Senior or Staff level, or equivalent
* Experience with server\-side (back\-end) technologies such as, Django, Flask, Fast API
* Experience with client\-side (front\-end) technologies such as React, Angular, Vue.js, HTML and CSS
* Experience with cloud platforms and services (AWS, Azure, GCP) via Terraform Automation (good to have)
* Working knowledge (4\+ years) of Python
* Use Git as your main tool for versioning and collaborating
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, Github Actions
* Demonstrated interest with LLMs, Prompt engineering, Langchain
* Experience with workflow orchestration \- doesn’t matter if it’s dbt, Beam, Airflow, Luigy, Metaflow, Kubeflow, or any other
* Experience implementation of large\-scale structured or unstructured databases, orchestration and container technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to explain and discuss complex engineering technicalities with colleagues and clients from other disciplines at their level of cognition
* Curiosity, proactivity and critical thinking
* Strong computer science fundaments in data structures, algorithms, automated testing, object\-oriented programming, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance.
* Strong knowledge in designing API interfaces
* Knowledge of data architecture, database schema design and database scalability
* Agile development m
 
 ethodologies
* Travel is required. This position requires regional travel away from your home office/primary working location. Travel frequency and destinations will vary based on project needs.

title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
description:
**LEAD SOFTWARE ENGINEER** 




 Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 5,500\+ employees and 30,000\+
 



 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500\. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels,special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.
 



 Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
 



***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “name@cvent.com” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.* 









*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.* 









*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice. https://www.cvent.com/en/notice\-recruitment\-fraud.* 




**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future:** 




 Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation. Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI\-powered collaboration, we’d love to meetyou.
 



**Position Description:** 




 Cvent’s R\&D is currently looking for a talented Lead Software Engineer to join our Microapps team. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of TypeScript, Java, GraphQL, Next.js, React, Tailwind and experience leading a team that builds for builders. You should be a self\-starter capable of taking ambiguous requirements and coming up with aviable solution. You should also be able to design scalable, high\-performance solutions that empower our productdevelopment teams to create world\-class products. You will work closely with a cross\-functional team to design, build, maintain and support our Microapps team.
 



**What you will be doing:** 




 • Design solutions to complex problems, that are flexible, robust, and take into account business needs.
 



 • Work with modern Nrwl/Nx, JavaScript, Typescript, React, Tailwind, GraphQL and Java tech stack.
 



 • Collaborate with your Scrum Team in scoping, estimating, implementing, and testing new features and fixes.
 



 • Be communicative and reliable, so that others can depend on you.
 



 • Delivery of features, improvements, and fixes in a timely, predictable cadence.
 



 • Mentor other engineers on good practices, technologies, and patterns.
 



 • Show up as a team member, encouraging others through example in collaboration, productivity, effective communication, and love for details.
 



 • Collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry to work on complex Software as a Service (Saas) based applications
 



**What you will need for this position** 
 :
 



**Primary Skills:** 




 • Master\+ in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent work experience
 



 • 8\+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
 



 • Proficiency with JavaScript, Typescript and Java.
 



 • Experience developing with React as part of a team.
 



 • Excellent troubleshooting skills.
 



 • Experience prototyping quickly when needed.
 



 • Proven ability to work in a fast\-paced, agile environment and result\-oriented culture
 



 • Experience working with distributed teams.
 



 • Experience in leading an engineering team
 



 • Fluent in written and spoken English
 



 • Proven experience leading the strategic adoption of AI\-assisted development tools and agents (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, automation bots) across a team, including defining best practices, integrating with existing SDLC/CI\- CD workflows, and mentoring engineers on effective and responsible use
 



**Preferred Skills:** 




 • Experience presenting ideas, techniques, or approaches to other team members
 



 • Experience in full stack development ranging from front\-end user interfaces to backend systems
 



 • Experience with Node.js and Next.js
 



 • Experience with AWS
 



 • Experience with Nrwl/Nx

 43988
   

  

**In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences \- together. With a customer\-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.**
**About The Role.**
 The Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE), Snacking serves as the bridge between advanced technology capabilities and practical business application across McCain’s Snacking business. This role partners directly with business stakeholders to deploy AI, automation, data, and digital solutions that improve commercial performance, product innovation, customer engagement, supply chain effectiveness, operational efficiency, and decision\-making.
   

  

 Working at the intersection of business and technology, the FDE translates business opportunities into scalable AI\-enabled solutions by partnering with Snacking teams, Digital Technology, Data \& Analytics, AI Engineering, Security, Legal, and other cross\-functional stakeholders. The role ensures solutions are deployed responsibly, adopted by users, integrated into existing workflows, and scaled where measurable business value is demonstrated.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Deploy practical solutions that support product innovation, portfolio management, customer engagement, commercial execution, demand planning, supply chain optimization, and operational excellence.
* Lead or support pilots, proofs of concept, and rapid experimentation efforts to validate business value before broader deployment.
* Define success measures, adoption criteria, business outcomes, and evaluation frameworks for new solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to test solutions in real\-world business environments and recommend whether initiatives should scale, refine, pause, or retire.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve productivity, insight generation, decision\-making, customer experiences, and business processes.

* Identify data, process, and technology gaps that may impact solution effectiveness and work with stakeholders to address them.

* Gather user feedback and continuously improve deployed solutions based on business needs and outcomes.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications and technical concepts into clear business language.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Proven ability to balance innovation, business value, risk management, and operational realities.
* Experience working effectively in a global, matrixed enterprise environment.
* Understanding of privacy, security, responsible AI, compliance, and data governance principles.
* Experience supporting pilots, experimentation, and scaled deployment of AI\-enabled business solutions is highly desirable.

**About The Team.**
 The Forward Deployment Engineer, Snacking is a senior individual contributor within McCain’s AI and Digital organization. The role partners closely with Snacking business leaders, Digital Technology, AI Engineering, Data \& Analytics, Security, Legal, and cross\-functional teams to accelerate the deployment of high\-value AI and digital solutions. Working in a highly collaborative and fast\-paced environment, the FDE helps bring innovative technologies into day\-to\-day operations while ensuring strong governance, adoption, and measurable business impact.

title: Technical Product Specialist - Global Social Responsibility
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
 You are someone who thrives in a high\-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
   

  

 In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well\-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
   

  

 When you join us, you will have:
   

  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast\-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family.


**Your Impact**
 You will be responsible for the day\-to\-day management, continuous improvement, and operational health of the learning technology stack that powers learner experiences and program delivery.
   

  

 This includes supporting the LMS, key SaaS integrations (e.g., Marketo), reporting and data flows, and custom operational tooling.
   

  

 You will work closely with programming teams, vendors, and firm Learning Technology colleagues to gather requirements, identify enhancement opportunities, maintain platform reliability, and coordinate delivery of technical improvements. You will help define and maintain the product roadmap for the GSR learning technology ecosystem, recommending priorities and enhancements based on user needs, operational considerations, and platform opportunities. You will help with major roadmap decisions, strategic tradeoffs, and platform evolution initiatives will be developed in partnership with and syndicated through the Learning Technology team to ensure alignment with broader firm technology strategy. Your success requires strong technical judgment, effective vendor and stakeholder coordination, and the ability to balance operational excellence with continuous platform improvement in support of the Global Social Responsibility (GSR) mission\-driven learning programs.
   

  

 You will support platform performance, resilience, integrations, security, and vendor\-orchestrated delivery while partnering across program teams, firm functions, and external providers to deliver a high\-quality learner experience at scale.
   

  

 You will help define and maintain the technical product roadmap across the LMS, integrations, reporting, and operational tooling by gathering requirements, prioritizing enhancements, evaluating technical solutions, identifying automation and process improvement opportunities, assessing risks and dependencies, and contributing recommendations for future platform capabilities in partnership with the Learning Technology Product Manager.
   

  

 You will serve as the day\-to\-day steward of the GSR learning technology ecosystem by monitoring platform health, coordinating incident response, supporting root\-cause analysis, maintaining visibility into operational risks and dependencies, and driving continuous service improvement.
   

  

 You will support learner, program, and operational data flows by translating reporting requirements into technical solutions, improving data quality and reporting usability, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
   

  

 You will manage day\-to\-day platform operations, including configuration, integrations, release coordination, change management, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, and lightweight technical enhancements while improving platform maintainability and supporting adoption of new capabilities.
   

  

 You will serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for technology vendors by coordinating issue resolution, managing vendor\-delivered enhancements, monitoring service performance, supporting sourcing and renewal decisions, and ensuring alignment with firm technology governance, architecture, and security standards.
   

  

**Your Qualifications and Skills**
* University degree or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred
* 5\+ years of experience in technical product management, platform operations, enterprise systems, learning technology, or a closely related field
* Experience supporting business\-critical SaaS platforms, integrations, and enterprise technology ecosystems
* Working knowledge of LMS technologies, APIs, SSO/SAML, CRM/marketing automation integrations, data pipelines, reporting platforms, and cloud\-based systems
* Experience with platforms such as Docebo, Marketo, AWS, Domo, Tableau, Power BI, Snowflake, or comparable technologies
* Experience managing external vendors and service providers against SLAs, KPIs, roadmaps, budgets, and security/compliance expectations
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize work, manage multiple initiatives, and drive delivery in a fast\-paced environment
* Product management skills, including requirements gathering, backlog management, roadmap planning, and cross\-functional coordination
* Strong technical aptitude with experience supporting platform operations, integrations, automation, reporting workflows, and continuous improvement
* Analytical problem\-solving skills with the ability to leverage data, metrics, structured analysis, and GenAI\-assisted tools to troubleshoot issues and implement practical solutions
* Sound judgment, adaptability, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities, evaluate tradeoffs, build productive partnerships, and escalate strategic decisions appropriately
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders

title: Manager - Integration, Ultra
description:
Designation: Manager Integration
   

  

 Location:Gurugram/Bangalore/Mumbai
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a technically proficient and detail\-oriented Integration Manager to own and manage end\-to\-end technical integrations, attribution implementations, and measurement infrastructure across Ultra’s web and mobile ecosystem.The role will involve working closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Business teams, advertisers, and external technology partners to design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize integrations across the advertising ecosystem.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of AdTech, mobile/web attribution, APIs, tracking, postbacks, data flows, and third\-party platform integrations, along with the ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical issues.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end integration lifecycle, including requirement gathering, technical implementation, testing, validation, deployment, and ongoing support.
* Design, implement, and maintain integrations with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs) such as AppsFlyer, Singular, Branch, Adjust, Kochava, AppMetrica, and similar platforms.
* Configure and manage tracking links, postbacks, APIs, server\-to\-server (S2S) integrations, and data pipelines to ensure accurate attribution and reporting.
* Manage technical integrations across mobile apps and web platforms, including tracking implementation, redirects, URL parameters, domain configurations, conversion tracking, and attribution flows.
* Drive technical onboarding of advertisers and partners, ensuring integrations are implemented, tested, and validated as per requirements.
* Work with Product and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical integration specifications and implementation plans.
* Troubleshoot API failures, postback issues, attribution discrepancies, tracking inconsistencies, data mismatches, and integration errors across internal and external platforms.
* Conduct integration testing and data validation to ensure accuracy, reliability, and consistency of data flows across systems.
* Use SQL, Excel, and database queries to analyze data, identify root causes, validate integrations, and resolve technical issues.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to manage technical escalations and integration\-related issues within defined timelines.
* Maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation, integration specifications, troubleshooting guides, and process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to automate and improve existing integration processes, reducing manual intervention and improving scalability.
* Stay updated on developments in AdTech, attribution methodologies, privacy frameworks, tracking technologies, APIs, and MMP platforms to continuously enhance Ultra’s integration capabilities.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 4\-8 years of experience in AdTech, Ad Operations, Technical Operations, Integrations, Mobile Measurement, Digital Advertising, or a related technology\-driven environment.
* Strong understanding of mobile and web attribution, campaign tracking, postbacks, conversion tracking, and end\-to\-end data flows.
* Hands\-on experience with MMPs such as AppsFlyer, Singular, Branch, Adjust, Kochava, AppMetrica, or similar platforms.
* Strong experience in implementing and troubleshooting REST APIs, S2S integrations, webhooks, and technical tracking solutions.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Affise or similar campaign management/tracking platforms.
* Good understanding of URLs, redirects, URL parameters, domains, cookies, tracking mechanisms, and mobile app measurement.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with hands\-on experience in SQL, Excel, and database queries.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and drive issues through to resolution.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Data, Business teams, advertisers, and technology partners.


 Work Environment Details:
   

  

 About Affle:
   

  

 Affle 3i Limited (NSE: AFFLE and BSE: 542752\) is a global technology company enabling verticalized AI\-led consumer conversions for advertisers globally, powered by the differentiated CPCU business model across Mobile, CTV and other agentic/autonomous intelligent connected devices (AICDs). Affle enables advertisers to optimize targeting, personalize user engagement and maximize ROI by combining proprietary data, deep audience intelligence and advanced generative AI capabilities.
   

  

 Affle 3i Consumer Platform delivers verticalized solutions across industries and geographies at scale, helping marketers engage with audiences in more relevant and meaningful ways. With innovative technology integrations, Affle maximizes user engagement at every stage of the consumer journey across connected devices. Its AI\-powered agents and algorithms go beyond automation and efficiency to deliver next\-gen experiences through deep human\-vs\-non\-human data distillation.
   

  

 For more details, please visit: www.affle.com
   

  

 About BU:
   

  

 Ultra Platform offers a unified access to seamlessly integrate multiple inventory sources, including walled gardens, so that you can extract maximum value from your leads, enhance conversion rates, and accelerate your business goals across mobile and mobile web
   

  

 For more details: www.ultraplatform.io/

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Department:** 
 Tech \- Software Engineering
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
   

  




**Description**
 Based in Gurugram, you will lead our newly established software team (currently four engineers) as we enter an exciting new phase of expansion. We are seeking an Engineering Manager who will build a strong, happy, high\-performing team, creating the environment, clarity, and support that enables people to do their best work. This is a people\-first role: you will have proven strength in leadership, scaling teams, and developing others. You will report to the Head of Software Product Engineering.
   

  

 Aurora’s mission is to help drive the energy transition through data\-driven energy market intelligence and software that supports decision\-makers across the power system. You will partner closely with colleagues in Oxford and across the business to help the team build customer\-facing software that delivers on this mission.
   

  

 Our platform includes microservices and modern web applications (TypeScript/Node, React, AWS). While this is a leadership\-focused role, you will still do some hands\-on senior engineering work, contributing code when needed, leading by example on quality, and helping the team make sound technical decisions
   

  

 You will establish the people and process foundations for an effective engineering team: regular 1:1s, coaching and feedback, inclusive ways of working, and strong delivery practices (planning, stand\-ups, reviews, and retrospectives). A key part of the role is growing the team through hiring, attracting, assessing, and onboarding great talent in Gurugram.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and grow the Gurugram engineering team, creating a positive, inclusive, high\-trust culture with strong team health and engagement.
* Hire, onboard, and retain great engineers, owning the hiring process end\-to\-end in partnership with HR and engineering leadership.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members through 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, and growth plans; support performance management when needed.
* Contribute as a senior engineer: write and review code, guide architecture and technical design, and continuously raise the bar on engineering standards (testing, reliability, and maintainability).
* Run effective engineering processes and ceremonies (planning, daily coordination, reviews, and especially high\-quality retrospectives) that drive continuous improvement and predictable delivery.
* Partner with Product and stakeholders to shape priorities, manage expectations, and ensure the team delivers valuable outcomes with a sustainable pace and high quality


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Required attributes:** 
* Strong people leadership and emotional intelligence: able to build trust, communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations, and foster psychological safety.
* Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineers (including regular 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, and progression support), with a genuine interest in people development.
* Demonstrated hiring capability: defining roles, running structured interviews, assessing both technical and behavioural skills, and making high\-quality hiring decisions.
* Experience running effective team processes (e.g., planning, reviews, and retrospectives) and using outcomes to drive continuous improvement.
* Able to lead within a distributed environment and collaborate effectively with Oxford\-based colleagues through proactive communication and inclusion.
* Experience working hands\-on with our (or similar) stack: Node/TypeScript, ExpressJS, React, SQL/NoSQL, AWS and microservices.
* Strong organisational skills: can balance competing priorities, create clarity, and follow through on commitments.


**Desirable attributes:** 
* Experience using delivery metrics (e.g., DORA) to inform team practices.
* Experience with engineering quality practices such as unit testing and CI/CD pipelines.


**What we offer**
 Some of the benefits we include are:
 * Accidental, term life and medical insurance
* Hybrid Work model
* Employee’s Provident Fund Scheme
* Maternity leave
* A fun, informal, collaborative and international work culture
* Access to the Aurora Academy, our training programme offering a range of opportunities to develop your skills within the responsibilities of your role and within the wider context of the industry.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), offering a complete support network that offers expert advice and compassionate guidance 24/7/365, covering a wide range of personal and professional aspects


 The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavorable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity.
   

  

 To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period.
   

  

 Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**
  

**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  

 At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
   

  

 Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
   

  

 In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being.
   

  

**Our Mission** 
 is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.
   

  

  

  

**Our Values** 
 underpin everything we do.
   

* **Customer Centric:** 
 Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
* **Passion for Learning:** 
 We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
* **Integrity:** 
 Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
* **Action \& Ownership:** 
 We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
* **One Team:** 
 We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
* **Global Mindset:** 
 We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.


**Global Benefits**
* Remote First Culture
* Health Care Coverage\*
* Education Reimbursement\*
* Competitive Paid Time Off
* Self\-Care Days
* National Holidays\*
* 2 Founder Days \+ Juneteenth Observed
* Paid Volunteer Time\*
* Charitable contribution match\*
* Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/\*
* Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
* Parental Leave\*
* Retirement Plan with match/contribution\*


 \* varies by country
   

  

**Seeing Beyond the Job Ad**
  

 At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad.  We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

title: IAM Development Engineer
description:

 As an
 **IAM Development Engineer at Topsoe**

 You will work with
 **SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC)**

From analysis and design to testing, deployment, rollback, and stabilization, you will help deliver solutions that are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with Topsoe’s IAM architecture.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop and maintain IAM connectors for enterprise applications, including SAP and other connected systems.

* Create and maintain technical documentation and contribute to knowledge\-transfer activities.
* Improve development processes, integration patterns, and operational practices.


**What You Will Bring**
 You have a strong background in integration and development, combined with an understanding of identity provisioning and IAM processes. You are comfortable working in a global corporate environment and collaborating with technical teams, application owners, and stakeholders.
   

  

**We Are Looking For Experience With**
* REST APIs, JSON, XML, and SCIM.
* OAuth2, client credentials, certificates, tokens, and other authentication methods.
* Java, JavaScript, Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting and development languages.
* Git and version control systems.
* Debugging, log analysis, and technical troubleshooting.
* Identity provisioning, application integrations, and lifecycle processes.

* SQL\-based applications and enterprise platforms.
* Designing or maintaining role\-based access models.
* Working with global teams and complex system dependencies.

You will play a key role in transferring critical IAM platform knowledge and responsibility from our external partner to the internal team, ensuring a strong foundation for future growth and security. As part of your responsibilities, you will assist with onboarding new applications to the IAM platform, making a tangible impact on our IT landscape. This is a chance to contribute to a collaborative environment, drive innovation, and be at the forefront of Topsoe’s digital transformation.
   

  

**Your New Team**
 You will join a dedicated internal IAM team of four professionals and play an important role in building Topsoe’s future IAM capabilities. Together, you will help transfer critical platform knowledge and responsibilities from our external partner to the internal team.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on Topsoe’s IT landscape while contributing to a collaborative environment focused on security, innovation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Help shape and strengthen Topsoe’s internal IAM function.
* Support the onboarding of new applications to the IAM platform.
* Develop reliable and scalable integration patterns.
* Improve identity lifecycle and access management processes.

 .

 **Lead Engineer (5–8 years’ experience)**

 The Lead Engineer operates primarily as a
 **strong tech enthusiast** 
 , leading through technical depth rather than people management. Success in this role is defined by strong ownership of code and systems, pragmatic design decisions, predictable delivery, and the ability to lift the technical capability of the team through mentoring and example.
 



 This role has strong visibility and impact, particularly in building and evolving REA’s advertising platforms and data\-driven products used at scale.

**Technical Execution:** 



* Own and deliver complex, high\-impact features across the full stack.
* Write, review, debug, and test production\-grade code aligned with REA engineering standards.
* Lead by example in code quality, correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Actively participate in pairing, code reviews, unit testing, and secure deployments.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs across performance, reliability, scalability, and time\-to\-value.
* Take accountability for technical deliverables from implementation through production.



  





**Design \& Architecture:** 



* Design solutions aligned with established architectural patterns and system constraints.
* Contribute to subsystem\-level design and support broader architectural decisions.
* Drive technical spikes and proof\-of\-concepts where deeper validation is required.
* Collaborate with Tech Leads and Engineering Managers to ensure designs align with long\-term technical direction.



  





**System Ownership \& Operational Excellence:** 



* Own the health of delivered systems in production, including reliability, performance, and observability.
* Identify and address operational risks, scalability concerns, and technical debt early.
* Support incident analysis, remediation, and continuous improvement of system resilience.
* Ensure delivered solutions are operable, supportable, and production ready.



  





**Delivery Leadership:** 



* Contribute to planning, estimation, and sequencing of work to support predictable delivery.
* Identify risks and cross\-team dependencies early and help unblock the team.
* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, and Delivery roles to balance scope, quality, and timelines.
* Support effective ways of working within the squad.



  





**People \& Technical Leadership:** 



* Mentor and coach engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and technical guidance.
* Share knowledge through technical sessions and informal coaching.
* Help raise the technical bar and reinforce strong engineering practices across the team.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and learning\-oriented team culture.



  





**What We’re Looking For:** 



* Strong hands\-on experience building and operating full\-stack systems using modern JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (React, Node.js).
* Demonstrated ability to own complex features and deliver them reliably to production.
* Solid system design skills with experience evolving systems over time.
* Strong experience with SQL databases and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB).
* Hands\-on experience with AWS RDS or other managed relational database services.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS), containers (Docker), and observability tooling.
* Good understanding of TDD, CI/CD, and modern delivery practices.
* Exposure to Media / AdTech domains (e.g., bidding platforms, DSPs/SSPs, tagging, CDPs, privacy\-enhancing technologies) is highly desirable.
* Ability to influence technical outcomes without formal authority.
* Clear communicator who collaborates effectively with cross\-functional and global teams.
* Pragmatic problem\-solver who balances doing things right with getting things done.
* Experience working with relational and/or non\-relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, DynamoDB).



  





**Bonus Skills:** 



* Experience with GraphQL, PHP, Functional Programming, or AWS\-native architectures.
* Experience building systems that operate at scale and handle high\-throughput traffic.



  





**Why join REA Cyber City:** 



* Work on globally impactful products used by millions.
* Be part of a growing global engineering organization with strong technical standards.
* Influence systems, teams, and culture from an early stage.
* Collaborate closely with global leaders and technologists.
* Grow as a people leader, delivery owner, and technology leader.



  





**The values we live by:** 




 Our values are at the core of how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions. We believe that how we work is equally important as what we do to achieve our goals. This commitment is at the heart of everything we do, from the way we interact with colleagues to the way we serve our customers and communities.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

title: Product Engineer (Founding Team), RAYY
description:
**Gurugram, hybrid · Full\-time · 3–5 years · Start 1 October 2026 · Immediate joiners preferred** 




  





**﻿
 
 About RAYY** 




 RAYY is a booking marketplace for sports academies, fitness classes and kids' learning
 



 activities, live in Gurugram and expanding to a second city. We are a small, fast\-moving team
 



 raising our first institutional round, and we are bringing engineering in\-house now.
 



**The role** 




 You will be one of the first two engineers at RAYY, working directly with the CPTO. The product
 



 is a Flutter customer app, a FastAPI backend on MongoDB, and Next.js dashboards for partners
 



 and our own team, on AWS. You will work end to end across all of it rather than in one layer.
 



 There is a full roadmap of customer\-facing features shipping this quarter, a backlog to clear,
 



 and releases to take over from our vendor; you will be building from day one and helping set
 



 how we build as the team grows.
 



**What you'll do** 




 Own features from API to screen across Flutter, Python and TypeScript. Fix, refactor and extend
 



 code you did not write. Ship to the Play Store and App Store and keep production healthy. Use
 



 AI coding tools as a normal part of your work, and review what they produce with the same
 



 care as your own. Write tests where they matter, especially anywhere money moves.
 



**What we're looking for** 




 Three to five years at a product company, with at least one consumer app shipped to real
 



 users; payments or marketplace experience is a plus. Working ability in at least two of Flutter,
 



 Python and TypeScript, and the willingness to work in all three. Familiarity with MongoDB, a
 



 payment gateway such as Razorpay, and AWS basics. Comfort with small teams and
 



 ambiguity: you would rather ship and learn than wait for a spec. Clear communication, since
 



 you will talk to partners and the CEO, not only to engineers. Available to start on or around 1
 



 October.
 



**Nice to have** 




 Experience at a food, fitness or booking marketplace. Prior work taking over a codebase from
 



 an agency or vendor. Flutter release tooling or Next.js.
 



**How we work** 




 Five\-day week, hybrid from our Gurugram office, with flexibility around business needs during
 



 launches and our fundraise. Small PRs, fast reviews, outcomes over hours. You will be judged
 



 on what ships and whether it stays up.
 



**Compensation** 




 Fixed salary, competitive for stage and experience.
 



**Process** 




 A short call with the CPTO, a two\-hour take\-home on our stack (use whatever tools you like; we
 



 discuss the diff together), and a conversation with the CEO. The whole loop fits in five days,
 



 and we can start you within a week of offer.
 



**To apply** 




 Send a CV or LinkedIn profile and a link to something you've shipped to hr@rayy.io with
 



 "Product Engineer" in the subject line.

title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer (Java+React)
description:
**About The Project**
 Bhawana is a greenfield build — You will help design and ship the Bhawana Loan Management System (LMS), the central platform Bhawana Capital uses to manage loans originated through Lending Service Providers (LSPs) in India. The stack spans partner APIs, an internal operations UI, LSP self\-service screens, automated underwriting, disbursement, EMI servicing, and regulatory reporting.
   

  

 The team is small, senior, and moves fast. We work in a spec\-first, AI\-augmented way: specifications are authored with AI assistance (Spec Kit), code is written and reviewed with AI copilots in the loop, and we expect every developer to use these tools fluently to raise their throughput and quality — not replace their judgement.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Together with Lead Engineer and Tech Lead, design and build the LMS end\-to\-end — Java/Spring backend services and React operations/partner UIs — on the latest technologies.
* Deliver production\-grade code: pull\-request reviews, high test coverage and production observability (Kibana, Elastic APM, Prometheus/Grafana).
* Work effectively with AI coding assistants — use them to accelerate implementation, review, refactoring, and documentation while remaining accountable for the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything that ships.
* Contribute to the spec\-first workflow: read and refine feature specifications, break specs into JIRA stories, flag missing scope early.
* Own features across the stack — from Kafka event contracts and REST endpoints down to the React screens partner staff and Bhawana operators actually use.
* Go the extra mile: stay current on tooling and techniques (including AI tooling), share what you learn, and push technical improvements proactively.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 10\+ years building production systems in Java (17\+) and the Spring ecosystem (Boot, REST, JPA/Data, Security, Integration). You know why @Transactional is more subtle than it looks, you have debugged classloader and GC issues in anger, and you can reason about JVM behaviour under load.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on React user interfaces — not prototypes, not admin screens generated from a template. You understand rendering, state, forms at scale, accessibility, and the cost of every dependency you add.
* Demonstrable fluency with AI coding assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex, or equivalent) as part of your daily workflow — able to prompt effectively, review AI output critically, and know when not to trust it.
* Clean\-code habits: patterns/anti\-patterns awareness, well\-structured, testable, maintainable, documented code.
* Distributed\-systems maturity — you reason about failure modes, retries, backoff, poison messages, and what happens when the network partitions during a disbursement. You've built and operated microservices in production and know when not to use them.
* Solid grasp of REST API design, integrations, refactoring, secure coding, APM and troubleshooting.
* understanding JIRA and able to write specifications there with Acceptance Criteria.
* Hands\-on experience with asynchronous messaging (Kafka or other)
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to break down complex domain problems and communicate solutions clearly.
* 6\+ years in lending technology or NBFC/bank ops\-tech roles, with at least one LMS/LOS implementation done end to end (FinnOne, Pennant, Lentra, M2P, Finflux or similar \- lender side or vendor side)
* Knows the RBI digital lending guidelines well enough to spec a KFS or an FLDG ledger without being handed the circular
* Strong team player, comfortable working independently, solid written and spoken English.


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with microservice architecture, event sourcing, distributed systems, authentication (OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC).
* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS or B2B2C platforms (partner isolation, tenant\-scoped data access).
* Financial\-services or lending\-domain background (loans, EMI, disbursement, DPD, collections).
* Working knowledge of: Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, Camunda BPM, Kotlin, Liquibase, Kibana, Elastic APM, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, ElasticSearch, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Frontend depth: state management (Redux Toolkit / Zustand / React Query), component libraries, accessibility, i18n.
* Experience with spec\-driven or contract\-first development (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Avro).
* Comfort with Gitflow, SonarQube, Maven/Gradle, Swagger/OpenAPI, JIRA, GitHub)


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not a vibecoding job. We don't ship prompt output blindly, we don't measure velocity by tokens, and we don't accept "the AI wrote it" as an answer in review, we are working in highly regulated sector.
* Not ticket\-in / PR\-out. You'll be expected to influence architecture, not just implement it.
* Not front\-of\-house UI polish. The React work is operational and partner\-facing; correctness and clarity matter more than pixel perfection.


**What We Offer**
* Greenfield project — you shape the architecture, not fight legacy.
* Senior, spec\-driven team where AI tooling is embraced, not tolerated.
* Direct impact on a regulated financial product entering a major new market.
* Modern stack, minimal ceremony, code review culture that raises the bar.


**We Offer**
* A Truly Global Workplace – collaborate with 40\+ nationalities across 25\+ countries, embracing diversity, inclusion, and cross\-cultural innovation
* Hybrid \& Flexible Work – balance your life and career with remote\-friendly policies and modern offices across Europe
* A Culture of Growth – accelerate your development with access to LinkedIn Learning, structured mentorship, and internal leadership programmes (HiPo \& People Leader tracks)
* Workation Programme – work remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year and experience new cultures while staying connected and productive
* Financial Growth Opportunities – invest in your future with our share purchase matching programme, doubling your contributions and fostering long\-term rewards
* Medical Coverage – group medical insurance covering hospitalisation and essential care
* Accident Protection – personal accident insurance for peace of mind


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support specific parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses against predefined criteria. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. All final hiring decisions are made by human recruiters.
   

  

 By proceeding to apply for a job with us, you confirm that you have read and accepted our Recruitment Privacy Policy

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
 We are seeking a Forward\-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high\-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
   

  

 You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent\-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands\-on builder, deep product architect, and first\-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain\-Specific AI Integration**
 Architect Intent\-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high\-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
   

  

 Context\-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain\-specific Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
   

  

 Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core\-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
   

  

**Product Delivery \& SDLC Acceleration**
 Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain\-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
   

  

 Establish Guardrails \& AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human\-in\-the\-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2\).
   

  

 Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature\-to\-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge\-case test generation.
   

  

**Forward\-Deployed Customer Engagement**
 Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
   

  

 Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high\-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
   

  

 Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C\-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
   

  

 Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi\-agent orchestration, AI Observability
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

**Must\-Have Qualifications And Experience**
 Experience: 15\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5\+ years spent delivering high\-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
   

  

 Technical Fluency: Deep, hands\-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE\-based assistants.
   

  

 Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.

 Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
   

  

 Background in customer\-facing technical roles such as Forward\-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:**

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
